entities.summary: Paul Carl Meger was a Canadian professional ice hockey forward. Meger played his entire National Hockey League (NHL) career with the Montreal Canadiens, winning the Stanley Cup in 1953. His career lasted from 1949 until 1955. Meger was born in Watrous, Saskatchewan, but grew up in Selkirk, Manitoba.
